description_expanded: OverviewHot TubNewly Renovated Condo Above Seacrest Shops and Restaurants- Private Beach- Heated Community Pool `The Wellington`The Space The Wellington – Newly Renovated Seacrest Beach Condo! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Newly Renovated in 2023! – Stylish & modern coastal elegance Spacious & Luxurious Master Suite – Stearns & Foster pillow-top King bed Private Balcony from Master Suite – Relax with scenic 30A views Chef’s Kitchen with High-End Features – Granite countertops, GE appliances & premium dishware Open-Concept Living & Dining – Farmhouse table perfect for meals & game nights Pool & Beach Access with Free Shuttle Pick-Up – Easy & convenient transportation Washer & Dryer In-Unit – Quick laundry between beach & pool days Comfortably Sleeps 7 Guests – 3 Bedrooms / 2 Bathrooms Walking Distance to Restaurants & Shops – Explore Seacrest Towne Centre & nearby attractions Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained General Parking Available –Convenient & hassle-free Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a seamless vacation experienceWelcome to The WellingtonNEWLY RENOVATED IN 2023!When you walk in the door of The Wellington, the elegance will capture you and bring you into this impeccable, cottage feeling condo. This Seacrest Beach condo has 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms along windows with beautiful views, professionally decorated furnishings, and all the comforts of home. With a mix of comfortable, contemporary furnishings, The Wellington will give you just the escape you need.The chef's kitchen is loaded with features including granite counter-tops, GE appliances, high-end kitchen tools and dishware for your at-home dining pleasure. The washer/dryer makes for quick loads of laundry between your beach/pool hopping. The kitchen opens to the dining area with a large farm-table that seats 6-8, and is perfect for marathon games of Monopoly, Uno, or whatever your favorite games might be.The living area features an open concept to dining area and kitchen. It flows to a balcony overlooking scenic 30-A with an ideal spot to eat breakfast, read the paper, or sip a beverage and take in the fresh salt air!The master bedroom with plantation shutters was designed with your comfort in mind. Get a great night's sleep on a Stearns & Foster pillow-top king-sized bed after a day of beach fun, so you can wake up refreshed and do it all over again! The master bath includes a luxurious, over-sized shower a Jacuzzi spa-tub, and double vanity. The guest bedroom features a Stearns & Foster queen bed and TV. The third bedroom has a twin over twin with trundle bunk bed. Whether you want to go to the beach, the pool, find that perfect dress, or get a wonderful meal, it is ALL within walking distance.Don't feel like cooking? There are several restaurants within walking distance including the newly completed open huts with shops, and restaurants are surrounded by the grass-covered commons area of the Towne Centre. Each brightly colored, gabled unit is easily identified and inviting for both regular customers and newcomers alike. From sunglasses to souvenirs, hop into one of these kiosks to find just the right thing.Come stay with us to enjoy all the great activities and natural beauty this area has to offer!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** As of January 1, 2022, Golf Carts are prohibited in Seacrest Beach. Violators will be fined by the HOA.****Ongoing construction on the building**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (7):Master Bedroom: King Bed; Private Master BathGuest Bedroom 1: Queen BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed w/ Twin TrundleGuest Bathroom: Connecting Door to Guest Bedroom 2; Tub/Shower CombinationAREA ATTRACTIONS:Seacrest Beach is a tranquil coastal community nestled along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A, situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Known for its colorful Florida cottage-style homes, the neighborhood offers a relaxed, bike-friendly atmosphere with streets named like Flip Flop Lane and Beach Bike Way. The centerpiece is the expansive 12,000-square-foot Seacrest Lagoon Pool, one of the largest private pools in Florida, surrounded by lush landscaping and an amphitheater for community events. Residents and guests enjoy deeded beach access via a boardwalk or seasonal tram service, making it easy to reach the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters. The Village of South Walton serves as the town center, featuring Peddler’s Pavilion—a hub for bike rentals, casual dining, and boutique shopping. The community also boasts shaded walking trails, a farmers' market, and a relaxed pace that appeals to families and vacationers seeking both serenity and convenience.​Show less
